acceptance.gate: Phase 5 gate G5 per master-plan v2.1 §9: 13-cell merged model with 3 thermal steps converges; increment count within 2x of Coreform (15 accepted increments per step, zero cutbacks, zero severe-discontinuity iterations). No single scalar stress acceptance value — glass stress is a screening field (Weibull/fracture treatment out of scope), so the gate is convergence + qualitative residual-stress/PEEQ behavior.

boundary_conditions.coupling: ONE distributing coupling on the annular mounting surface (continuum rotational formulation, all 6 coupling DOFs active); control point carries resultant restraint with uniform distributing weights
boundary_conditions.glass_metal_interfaces: perfectly bonded via the merged multicell part sharing one spline field — NO Abaqus interaction/contact definition in the baseline
boundary_conditions.initial_temperature_field: 450 °C uniform predefined field over the complete assembly (stress-free starting state)

geometry.assembly: modified Fischer Connectors SFE 104 A056-130 STEP (substantially altered; NOT the manufacturer as-supplied geometry); 13 solid bodies Boolean-merged with intersections retained into one deformable part
geometry.cells: S-8061 glass seal (1) + eleven Alloy 52 pins (11) + 304L VAR header (1)

loads.type: spatially uniform prescribed temperature changes (STRESS analysis, not transient heat transfer; no gradients, dwell, cooling rate, glass relaxation, or viscoplasticity)

Alloy52_pins.alpha_range_note: midpoint of manufacturer 30-450 °C range; dotted extrapolation below 30 °C and above 450 °C
Alloy52_pins.plasticity_baseline: linear hardening sigma_y = 234.4 MPa + 1924 MPa * eps_bar^p; digitized 2007 power-law curve retained for sensitivity studies

S8061_glass.E_vs_T: digitized normalized annealed-specimen curve (Chambers et al.), normalized to 69 GPa at 25 °C; sharp modulus drop near 500 °C is rate-dependent, not a general elastic law above Tg
S8061_glass.behavior: thermoelastic ONLY (temperature-varying stiffness, no plasticity, no viscoelasticity/structural relaxation); baseline model capped at the 450 °C limit of the thermoelastic model
S8061_glass.density_expansion_provenance: supplier data + public Type 304 mean-expansion data with documented extrapolations

SS304L_header.elastic_expansion_plasticity: temperature-dependent tables at 20/100/200/300/400/500 °C (multilinear J2); -55 °C curve = full 20 °C curve scaled by 1.2 (ASSUMPTION per doc, not a measurement of the later 304L VAR heat)

mesh_sweep.discretization: immersed rectilinear IGA mesh (baseline), 0.5 mm initial development mesh — explicitly NOT a mesh-converged recommendation; refine until glass stress and metal PEEQ stop moving
mesh_sweep.note: Abaqus-side counts: 56595 elements, 66180 nodes, 198546 variables, 178278 equations; active 32098, cut 3420
mesh_sweep.solver_cost_reference: IGA mesh 318.8 s (16 MPI), Abaqus solve 691.0 s (16 threads)

nonlinear_settings.NLGEOM_note: Doc crawl did not capture an explicit NLGEOM on/off for the seal baseline (the alpha-workflow notice mentions NT skipped with warning; unsymmetric equation storage used after symmetric storage had convergence difficulty). Record as unknown pending re-read of the step-module sections.
nonlinear_settings.plasticity: J2 multilinear (304L T-dependent, Alloy52 linear-hardening baseline)
nonlinear_settings.storage: unsymmetric (baseline numerical definition; symmetric had convergence difficulty)

provenance.reference_doc_sections: §1.2 geometry/components, §1.3 thermal history + MMTS, §1.4 QoIs + Weibull hierarchy, §2 baseline material table + provenance codes, mesh Table 33 + 0.5mm caveat, coupling/steps/solver sections
provenance.reference_values_csv: research-coreform-IGA/user-guide/generated-downloads/example-problems/glass-to-metal-seal/glass-to-metal-seal-convergence-history.csv (per-increment accepted/iterations: 15+15+15, all accepted first attempt); glass-to-metal-seal-problem-size.csv (element/DOF counts); glass-to-metal-seal-performance.csv (timings); example-problems/glass-to-metal-seal/data/*.tsv/*.csv (Abaqus-pasteable elastic/expansion/plastic tables)
